title: Links — Worth Your Time
summary: A running list of links David Holt finds worth sharing: books, videos, articles, sites, no categorization, flat list, newest-appended-first.
note: The URL in 'data' is the real, always-current source of truth — a plain JSON array of every link in full, no HTML parsing needed and nothing else to fetch. This page's own fields (title/summary/etc.) are just orientation; don't treat this file as the link list itself.

data_schema.shape: An array of objects: { title: string, url: string, blurb: string }.
data_schema.display_order: The site renders the array in reverse, so the last item is shown first (newest-appended-first). The array itself has no date field to sort by.

author: David Holt
